document: Incident INC-9907: the search cluster was unavailable starting at 21:00 UTC; the auth service remained healthy throughout. Service was restored after 40 minutes. Initially filed as SEV2, it was re-classified to SEV1 during the review. Approximately 3,706 users were affected. Root cause is still under investigation.

schema.duration_minutes: integer: total outage duration in minutes
schema.root_cause: string: short root cause phrase; null if still under investigation
schema.severity: string: one of SEV1, SEV2, SEV3 as finally assigned (after any re-classification)
schema.start_time: string HH:MM (24h): when the outage began
schema.system: string: the affected system (not systems merely mentioned as unaffected)
schema.users_affected: integer: number of users affected; null if unknown
